decisions.reason: Explains sibling imports resolve against the chunk's own URL, siblings were never shipped, so the 200 entry still rejects the whole dynamic import; proposes a self-contained single-file chunk with splitting off plus a graph-completeness assertion.

Attributes the 403 to a case-sensitive startsWith across two pipelines (E: from import.meta.url vs e: from realpathSync); explains Linux byte-identical and laptop coincidental passes; explicitly rejects 'Windows paths unreliable' folklore and hedges the lowercase-drive generalization in residual risk.

Proposes canonicalizing both sides via realpathSync and path.relative containment rejecting .., absolute/different-volume and post-resolution symlink escapes, with platform-appropriate case folding; keeps the JavaScript MIME serving requirement.

Explains both handlers sit on one wheel event path; gives the open modal exclusive ownership with capture-phase preventDefault + stopPropagation and requires the pane handler to yield (ownership flag/composedPath or deregistration), noting capture-order limits.

T1–T3 cover chunk-graph completeness/deployability with rendered fallback assertion, case-mismatch allow vs traversal/symlink/escape refuse (Windows CI), and modal zoom without pane font change; framed as planned checks.

caps.reason: Final fix strengthens containment on canonicalized paths; no advice to disable containment or serve outside the resource root.
